title: A classic payment emits a transfer event (CAP-0067)
pattern: Since CAP-0067, classic operations emit the same events as the Stellar Asset Contract: a native payment emits transfer with from, to and the asset. Readers that take payments only from operations, or only from Soroban events, double-count or miss them.

hazards.placement: PaymentOp emits a CAP-0067 transfer event

facts.says: The operation emits a transfer event from alice to bob in native.
The amount is 1 XLM (10,000,000 stroops) as an i128.
The transaction-level events carry the fee charge.
